parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The moose, $Alces alces$, is a large member of the deer family. It lives in temperate forests in North America and northern Europe, where snow is present for large parts of the year.

Fig. 10.1 shows an adult male moose feeding in a lake.

{{figure:figure_10_1.webp}}

Fig. 10.1

The moose feeds on a plant in the lake called watermilfoil, $Myriophyllum aquaticum$.

The moose and the watermilfoil belong to the domain Eukarya, which includes the kingdoms Animalia and Plantae.

Describe the main differences between the kingdom Animalia and the kingdom Plantae.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Measurements of the surface temperature of land and oceans can be taken from locations around the world. The mean global surface temperature for land and ocean combined can be calculated for a fixed time period.

Scientists calculated:
- the mean global temperature for the twentieth century
- the mean global temperature for each decade (ten years) from 1880 to 2020.

The mean temperature for each decade was compared to the mean for the twentieth century. For each decade, the difference in temperature was calculated.

The calculated differences are shown in Fig. 10.2.

{{figure:figure_10_2.webp}}

Fig. 10.2

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Calculate the rate of increase in temperature per **decade** between 1980 and 2020.

Show your working.

Write your answer to **two** decimal places.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Moose populations have decreased in North America since 1980.

Suggest **and** explain reasons for the decrease in moose populations.
